title: USA₮ officially launches
description: Tether announced the launch of USA₮ as a federally regulated dollar-backed stablecoin issued by Anchorage Digital Bank.
notes: Launch date follows the dated official announcement.

title: AllUnity launches EURAU
description: AllUnity launched EURAU as Germany's fully reserved MiCAR-compliant euro stablecoin.

title: Noble Dollar launches
description: Noble launched USDN as a composable yield-bearing stablecoin built with the M0 stack.
notes: Separate from Neutrino USD and from vault or points-program layers.

title: USDH enters migration period
description: USDH entered a migration and liquidity-transition period while remaining fully backed and supported through designated routes.
notes: Exact migration start, final support date, and successor-liquidity boundary remain unresolved.

title: AE Coin operates under CBUAE payment-token authorization
description: AED Stablecoin LLC states that it is authorized by the Central Bank of the UAE to issue AE Coin through a B2B and appointed-agent model.
notes: Canonical launch date remains unresolved; this event records the verified regulatory operating context.
